uri.description: Function or Topic URI. See \ref ak_wwise_waapi_getfunctions and \ref ak_wwise_waapi_gettopics to get the lists of functions and topics.

includeExamples.description: Include the examples provided in the schema. Default value is false.

argsSchema.description: The argument schema. Only possible for functions.

resultSchema.description: The result schema. Only possible for functions.

publishSchema.description: The publish schema. Only possible for topics.

description.description: The description of the function or topic.

examples.description: The examples provided in the schema.

description: Retrieves the JSON schema of a Waapi Function or Topic URI.
